candidates.failure_scenario: urlToFile (crawl.go:486, documented at crawl.go:482-485) is where a gnoweb path becomes a static file, and it is what puts the tab query under `_t/` with a slug. comment.go never calls it for the tabs: tabs (line 154) concatenates `%s/_t/source/` and `%s/_t/help/` onto the base URL, and Index (line 174) concatenates the same two suffixes onto a file path.
